page_title: LEV 2-0 MAL | Levante v Mallorca 17/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+6' Dela (Levante) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort only crashes against the crossbar.
90+6' Dela (Levante) is going to take the penalty!
90+6' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) touches the ball with his hand inside the box! That is a penalty kick for Levante.
90+5' Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
90+4' Mallorca take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+2' Luis Castro has decided to make a change. Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) replaces Carlos Espi.
90+2' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jon Ander Olasagasti as he is replaced by Ugo Raghouber (Levante).
90+2' The substitution is prepared. Kareem Tunde (Levante) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ivan Romero.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
87' 2 - 0 Kervin Arriaga (Levante) leaps highest to meet a perfect corner kick and glances a header into the net behind the goalkeeper!
87' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Levante.
85' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Roger Brugue (Levante). He’s got to go!
85' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Johan Mojica (Mallorca) has to leave the pitch!
83' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) protests to the referee and receives a yellow card.
83' Roger Brugue (Levante) is booked for saying more than Javier Alberola was willing to tolerate.
82' Roger Brugue (Levante) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.
79' Here is a change. Manu Morlanes is going off and Martin Demichelis gives the last tactical orders to Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
79' The attendance for today's match is 22958.
78' Mathew Ryan (Levante) gets a yellow card. The referee Javier Alberola made the right call.
76' Miguel Calatayud (Mallorca) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
75' Carlos Espi (Levante) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went low to the middle of the goal, but Leo Roman made a easy save.
73' The free kick into the penalty area from Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) is cleared.
72' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
69' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Martin Valjent (Mallorca) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Miguel Calatayud.
69' The referee allows time for a substitution. Zito Luvumbo will be replaced by Takuma Asano (Mallorca).
68' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
67' Javier Alberola blows his whistle as Carlos Espi (Levante) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
66' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
65' Luis Castro has decided to substitute Iker Losada and he is replaced by Roger Brugue (Levante).
61' That's the end of the game for Pablo Torre, who is replaced by Jan Virgili (Mallorca).
60' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) commits a foul and Javier Alberola immediately signals a free kick.

59' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) makes a decision to dribble through the defence towards the goal. He gets inside the box, pulls the trigger, but hits the ball very poorly and it goes yards wide of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
57' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mathew Ryan intercepts the ball.
56' Carlos Espi (Levante) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
55' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
54' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball has crossed the sideline. Mallorca are taking a throw-in.
53' The free kick is delivered by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
52' Dangerous play by Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca). Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Ivan Romero (Levante) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
49' Samu Costa (Mallorca) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
48' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) sends a long ball in, but Mathew Ryan comfortably gathers the ball.
46' Half-time substitution. Martin Demichelis decided to make a change. David Lopez is replaced by Javier Olaizola (Mallorca).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Javier Alberola blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Samu Costa (Mallorca) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

45' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the top right corner, but Mathew Ryan easily deals with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
45' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

44' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) and Manu Morlanes have been trying to find each other with some accurate passes ever since the match started. These two definitely combine the most and are the team's most creative players.
41' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!
39' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
37' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
36' A player from Mallorca commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
35' The resulting set piece from Mallorca is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

35' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Mathew Ryan shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The referee points to the corner flag and Mallorca will take a corner.
32' 1 - 0 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Carlos Espi (Levante) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 1:0.
30' Nacho Perez (Levante) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
29' None of the Levante players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
29' Levante are awarded a free kick from long range.
26' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
26' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.
25' Mathew Ryan produces a crucial save to deny a close-range header from Samu Costa (Mallorca) after a cross. A top class save by the keeper. Corner kick. Mallorca will have an opportunity.
24' A cross is slung in towards the penalty spot and Iker Losada (Levante) creates space for himself but sends his header inches over the bar.
23' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Nacho Perez.
21' Good movement by Johan Mojica (Mallorca), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
20' Mallorca fail to score from a corner as Mathew Ryan (Levante) leaps to collect the ball.
19' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
17' Samu Costa (Mallorca) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
14' Ivan Romero (Levante) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Leo Roman, who smothers the ball.
13' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Levante comes to nothing.
12' Ivan Romero (Levante) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
11' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
10' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
8' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
6' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) sends a cross into the box, but Leo Roman comes off his line to gather the ball.
5' The free kick from long range, taken by Levante, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
4' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
2' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Mallorca will kick-off.
Javier Alberola got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
